content: Create a polished App Store promotional poster for an AI headshot app called {argument name="app name" default="Shine"}, in a warm minimalist brand style. Use a vertical smartphone screenshot ad layout on a soft beige background with a curved golden-yellow shape rising from the bottom edge. Place a large elegant black serif headline in the upper left, split across 3 lines, reading {argument name="headline text" default="Create pro headshots with Shine"}. Add a white jagged starburst badge to the left-center with black serif text reading {argument name="badge text" default="Before + After"}. On the right side, show a large angled modern smartphone mockup, slightly tilted left, with thin metallic edges and a realistic screen. The phone display should show the app interface for AI-generated professional headshots. At the top of the screen, include a small wordmark reading SHINE, a large serif subheadline saying "Your best self, professionally.", supporting body text saying "Upload a few photos and we’ll create studio-quality headshots.", a small rounded pill in the upper right that says "⚡ 8 credits", and an iPhone-style status bar showing 9:41. In the middle of the phone screen, show a before-and-after comparison card with 2 portrait panels side by side, each labeled exactly once: 1 left label "Before" and 1 right label "After". The left portrait is a casual man in a dark T-shirt against a plain indoor background; the right portrait is the same man transformed into a professional headshot wearing a dark blazer over a light shirt with a warm studio bokeh background. Put a circular swap arrow button centered between the 2 panels. Below that, include a "HOW IT WORKS" section with exactly 3 steps arranged vertically: 1) "1. Upload" with the text "Add 8–12 clear photos of yourself.", 2) "2. We create" with the text "Our AI generates a variety of pro headshots.", 3) "3. Download" with the text "Choose your favorites and download high-res images." Give each step a rounded square pastel icon tile in peach or pink tones. Near the bottom of the phone screen, add a large rounded yellow CTA button reading {argument name="button text" default="Start Shine ✦"}, and beneath it small text saying "8 credits per session". In the lower left foreground, place a cute stylized white mascot character with a rounded body, tiny arms, blush cheeks, dot eyes, and a smiling mouth, wearing a golden-yellow cowboy hat and matching neckerchief; the oversized hat should extend toward the center and overlap the base area in front of the phone. Use soft 3D illustration for the mascot, premium UI design for the phone screen, consistent beige-and-gold branding, subtle shadows, clean spacing, and a refined startup-marketing aesthetic.

Using the provided reference image, recreate the same retro game-cover composition as a polished 4K cinematic remake. Keep the large "ROLO TO THE RESCUE" title at the top, the horizontal framed key art layout, the jungle setting, and the lineup of 5 characters in the same left-to-right order: beaver in the water, squirrel on the bank, elephant in the center, blue rabbit, and mole emerging from a dirt mound with a miner helmet. Transform all 5 characters into cute semi-realistic 3D animated creatures with natural fur, skin, and soft stylization, while preserving their recognizable proportions and the nostalgic feel of the original cover. Clean up the composition so it looks like premium modern game promotional art, with warm golden-hour jungle lighting, richer depth, more realistic vegetation and water reflections, and a refined wooden frame. Remove any blurred or obscured facial areas and fully render every character clearly. Make the image wide, high-detail, family-friendly, and faithful to the original cover while feeling like a modern realistic remaster.

A polished anime-style illustration of a cute young woman sitting alone at a sunlit cafe table by a large window, framed from about thigh-up in a slightly front-facing seated pose. She has {argument name="hair color" default="light brown"} hair styled in 2 short twin ponytails tied with 2 deep blue ribbon bows, soft bangs, and a sweet youthful appearance. She wears a frilly white summer dress with small black polka dots, short puff sleeves, a fitted bodice, a large bow at the chest, and layered ruffles around the skirt. Her hands are clasped gently under her chin in a shy, cheerful pose, leaning slightly forward toward the viewer as if having a friendly cafe date. Place a small dessert plate on the table in the foreground with 1 mini tart topped with strawberries, blueberries, whipped cream, and a mint leaf, and beside it 1 tall glass of iced latte with a straw. The background is a warm modern cafe interior with wooden chairs and tables, pendant lamps, potted plants, wall decor, and a long window counter. Through the large windows, show bright green trees and a soft daytime urban street view. Lighting is warm natural afternoon sunlight streaming in from the right, creating soft highlights, gentle shadows, and a cozy inviting atmosphere. Highly detailed, clean linework, soft glossy shading, delicate fabric texture, charming romantic mood, high-quality anime illustration, square composition.

A retro late-1990s Japanese personal homepage displayed inside a Windows-era Microsoft Internet Explorer window, captured as a full browser screenshot. The page title bar reads "露夢の探し場 - Microsoft Internet Explorer" and the browser chrome is authentic to classic Internet Explorer, including menu bar, navigation icons, address bar, and status bar. The website itself has a black starfield space background with tiny colorful stars, framed by dotted gold borders and glowing pixel-style decorative boxes. The page header area shows purple Japanese text "秘密の花園へようこそ…" above a large ornate title "露夢の探し場" with the subtitle "Since 1998" in bright blue italic serif text. In the center is a low-polygon 3D anime girl with pink-red hair, blue crop top, dark shorts, white shoulder armor, brown boots, and a neutral front-facing pose. Count 4 game-like character or effect elements around her: 2 flames near the upper left and upper right of the center area, 1 blue pixel-art robot character on the lower left of the center area, and 1 small red-and-white pixel-art character on the lower right of the center area. Count 2 silver metallic hanging capsule ornaments near the upper center left and upper center right. Build the page in a dense old-web layout with 3 main columns. The left column contains 5 boxed sections: 1 navigation box titled "探し物は何ですか？" with exactly 10 star-bulleted blue links, labeled "最新情報", "怪し物掲示板", "ゲームの部屋", "教授の部屋", "ツールの部屋", "音楽の部屋", "絵の部屋", "BBS（掲示板）", "チャット", "リンク集"; 1 visitor counter box reading "あなたは、◯人目の探検者です" with green digital-style digits "003666"; 1 large blue "BBS" banner button with smaller text "掲示板はこちら"; 1 black-and-yellow caution-style "工事中 UNDER CONSTRUCTION" banner with tiny green worker figures; and 1 black banner with red script text "Link" plus blue text "相互リンク大歓迎!!". The center lower area contains 1 large news box with a gold dotted border and magenta heading "最新情報", listing exactly 5 dated update lines: "'99/06/20 新作ゲーム『Evil Heart』UP!! (NEW)", "'99/06/18 裏技『ストⅡ裏ワザ集』追加。", "'99/06/15 ツール『RPGエディタ Ver1.20』UP", "'99/06/10 音楽『MIDIコレクション』追加", "'99/06/05 絵の部屋にて『神秘師の巫女』UP"; below it add the blue link "過去の情報はこちら". The right column contains 5 boxed sections: 1 red warning box headed "◎ 重要なお知らせ ◎" with text "当サイトは違法性を推奨するものではありません。 すべて自己責任でお願いします。"; 1 dark purple box titled "禁断の館" with subtitle "入る勇気はあるか？" and a realistic skull image on the right; 1 purple box titled "露夢の隠し部屋" with the label "PASSWORD" and an empty white password field; 1 recommendations box titled "おすすめサイト" containing exactly 3 stacked banner buttons labeled "夢魔幻の城", "Game Center", and "PLAY ZONE"; and 1 bottom purple mail button labeled "✉ 露夢へメール". Add small footer text centered near the bottom: "※当サイトにあるすべてのデータの無断転載を禁じます。" and beneath it "Since 1998/3/15　露夢の探し場". Make the whole image feel like an authentic nostalgic Geocities-style Japanese web page from 1998–1999: garish colors, beveled buttons, bitmap fonts, glowing borders, amateur HTML layout, MIDI-homepage energy, slightly compressed screenshot quality, and uncanny period-accurate internet aesthetics.

A two-panel Japanese manga page in a dramatic, semi-realistic black-and-white ink style with warm sepia sunset tones. The setting is a public park at dusk with 1 wooden bench on the far left, 4 glowing lampposts, leafy trees, a dirt walking path, distant city buildings, and a small playground with slides in the background. In the top panel, a small Jack Russell Terrier stands left of center on a leash, just after pooping on the ground; there is 1 small poop pile near its hind legs with comic emphasis marks. The dog has a white coat with dark patches, a collar and leash, eyes squeezed shut, and a mischievous, satisfied expression while one hind leg is lifted and the tail is wagging, suggesting the start of a backward kick. To the right, a young woman with shoulder-length wavy hair crouches while holding an open plastic poop bag in one hand and the leash loop in the other. She wears a cable-knit cardigan, a long floral dress with a ribbon at the collar, and low heels. Her face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur. A large speech balloon in the upper right contains vertical Japanese text: 「よしよし。…さて、ササっと片付けて帰ろっか。」. In the bottom panel, create a sudden close-up action moment: the dog, now on the left side in a low aggressive stance, glares intensely with sharply angled brows, one sweat drop, and puffs of breath from its nose, as if bracing and kicking dirt backward with force. Explosive speed lines radiate across the frame, and a cloud of sand and grit bursts toward the crouching woman on the right. The woman recoils slightly, still holding the bag, with a shocked thought balloon near her head containing vertical Japanese text: 「あ、まずい……」. Next to the dog, place a jagged impact shout balloon with large Japanese text: 「フンッ！」. Emphasize the absurd humor and motion, with detailed fur, textured ground, dynamic debris, expressive manga screentones, bold panel borders, and cinematic action-comedy timing.
